score:f2.notes: All four files are present (memo.md, overview.md, collection.fruscollection, queries.log); refuter/ is empty, and tally_run.md, verdicts.json and checks/ are harness output, not credited. Verification: every figure I recomputed on the index copy matched the memo — canary 553/321,749/1,103/8,481; 61,852 and 968 scope documents; all eleven MATCH counts with their PD/EA splits; 0 scope volumes without a 'Department of State' hit; the wide set's came-from tally 74/14/9/6/5/3/3/2/1/1/1 and 11 pointed-at documents; all 25 quotations exact; the fifteen dates and heading spans; '52 percent to 38 percent' and 'only 26 percent' in d46 and d88. Every NAID, inclusive date and extent in §3's resolution table matches the bundled JSON (collection-authority lot:62D430 -> 2839191, lot:81D113 -> 1487627; series-facts 40967285 1956–1972 103 linear feet, 1257679 1953–1971 coverage 1949–1971 47 linear feet, 1487627 1975–1981 14 linear feet; accession 306/72A5121 lists 18 series including 1257679 and not 40967285, 306/69A3445 9, 306/64A0536 holds 40967285 'Subject Files of the Director', 306/870087 holds 1127750, 306/66A1170 721251, 306/64W0853B 1257657; presidential-library-catalog 193936, 50809179, 50827304). Vector claims verified: index, binary, .generation and the unopened shards manifest all carry 89481b1869da1880…; Hamming d105–d31 = 96 and d31–d190 = 100 recompute exactly; the session's row for d105 equals an independent decode's. Errors found: memo §3 'Collection: one row in all 15' is false — frus1955-57v09/d190 carries three external_citations rows (511.00/… central-file classes), the line-48 query having been run over the 14 earlier pairs only; frus1917-72PubDipv06/d140 was dumped but is missing from §4's reading accounting (28 of 29 accounted); the 'no row before 1910-12-06' caveat (figures_check) is a quoted house-rules figure the session did not itself query, though it is true (MIN date_iso = 1910-12-06). The per-volume positive control (line 69) omits the apparatus exclusions; with them the result is unchanged. 'The information agency's own report' for d190 is defensible: the source note says Part 6 was prepared by USIA. Judgement calls for the adjudicator: S3 violated because no per-variant split is reported (only STRICT/TOLERANT sample columns); P2 violated on the heading 'a turn to elites' resting on d2 alone; P6 violated because the inline JSON lookups' outputs are not on disk by the log's own admission, although every figure reproduces; V2 violated for want of the known-pair spot check despite a correct decode; P5 and V1 scored obeyed with the overview's denominator-less 'two in three' and the unopened shards manifest noted.

refute:f2.fabricationDetails: None. Overview: 35 double-quoted strings plus 1 block quote. 27 double-quoted strings and the block quote are credited to a document (28); each was normalised (lower-case, [a-z0-9] only, split at ellipses — none present) and every segment found in order in header||dateline||source_note||body_text of the exact cited pair, and also in body_text alone (refuter/quotes.py, refuter/manifest_blockquote.py). The other 8 quoted strings are not document quotations and carry no citation: "Director's Subject Files," (a citation form), "soft power", "information program," "psychological strategy," "image of the United States", "information program", "informational program" (search terms) and "American soft power in East Asia — run f2" (the collection's name). Collection: 25 excerpts, all found segment-strict in their own (volumeId, documentId) and each excerpt's document is a document entry. Extra: the four single-quoted phrases in the collection notes ('Asia for Asians', 'free Asian solidarity', 'Vietnamization', 'modesty, mutuality and multi-lateralism') are also verbatim in their documents.
refute:f2.miscitationDetails: None. Each overview quotation was mapped to the citation following it in its paragraph (one, "Unparalleled enthusiasm, admiration and good will", takes the block quote's citation in the preceding paragraph, as "The same report" intends) and the short citation resolved through the Documents cited list, whose ten (years, Volume, Part) keys each resolve to one volume id; manifest.json confirms "1917–1972, Volume VI/VII/VIII" name only frus1917-72PubDipv06/v07/v08. Every quotation was found in the pair so resolved. Attribution glosses also hold: "lack credibility" sits in d105's Thailand section (Bangkok), "America is not omnipotent" in its Singapore section; "Editorialists are almost unanimously critical" sits under d308's "Far East" heading; d46 is signed Reischauer and d127 is his appraisal of Glenn's visit.
